request.style: English, male baritone solo, acoustic guitar, piano, strings, soft drums, reverent, 72 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
When day came he called his disciples near
He chose twelve of them to draw him near
Simon whom he named the Cananaean
Stood within the list of those chosen

[Verse]
Gave them power over all demons there
And authority to heal the pain
Sent them out to proclaim the kingdom
Of God and heal the sick again

[Verse]
In the upper room they gathered close
With one mind they devoted themselves to prayer
Peter John and James and Andrew
Philip Thomas Bartholomew and more

[Verse]
Matthew James and Simon the Zealot
And Judas son of James were there
Mary the mother of Jesus too
And his brothers joined in prayer

[Outro]
Simon the Cananaean stands in the list
